text: The ___ matrix (denoted S), with metabolites as rows and reactions as columns, encodes the stoichiometric coefficient of every metabolite in every reaction and is the central data structure of constraint-based metabolic modeling.
explanation: The stoichiometric matrix S has one row per metabolite and one column per reaction, with entries S_ij giving the stoichiometric coefficient (positive if produced, negative if consumed, zero if uninvolved) of metabolite i in reaction j. It underlies the steady-state constraint S·v = 0 that defines the feasible flux space in FBA and related constraint-based methods.
